_comment: How many academic years of history a class-arm's seniority implies, in the standard JSS1-through-SS3 six-year run. Used only to sanity-check that a student's years[] array has a plausible length for their current class_arm -- the generator never fabricates history itself. Every year/term still comes from an explicit entry in that student's own JSON file, digitized:true or false as the real record says.
